theorem boundedRidgeBranchGradeArithmetic :
    let runFeet : Nat := 36
    let segmentFeet : Nat := 6
    let segmentCount : Nat := 6
    let headCount : Nat := 7
    let gradeTenthsInchPerTenFeet : Nat := 5
    let totalRiseTenthsInch : Nat := 18
    let segmentRiseTenthsInch : Nat := 3
    And (runFeet * gradeTenthsInchPerTenFeet = totalRiseTenthsInch * 10)
      (And (segmentFeet * gradeTenthsInchPerTenFeet = segmentRiseTenthsInch * 10)
        (segmentFeet * segmentCount = runFeet && headCount = segmentCount + 1)) :=
by decide

theorem manufacturerBandContainsBoundedGradeEnvelope :
    let manufacturerBandTenthsInch : Nat := 60
    let totalRiseTenthsInch : Nat := 18
    let baselineFreedomTenthsInch : Nat := 42
    manufacturerBandTenthsInch - totalRiseTenthsInch = baselineFreedomTenthsInch :=
by decide

theorem boundedGradeDoesNotPromoteExactOrWholeLayout :
    let boundedBranchPlanPathReady : Bool := true
    let boundedBranchGradeMagnitudeReady : Bool := true
    let boundedBranchGradeDirectionReady : Bool := true
    let boundedBranchDrainCatchmentReady : Bool := true
    let boundedDeflectorGradeEnvelopeReady : Bool := true
    let exactDeflectorElevationsReady : Bool := false
    let exactPipeCenterlineZReady : Bool := false
    let exactDrainRouteReady : Bool := false
    let wholeFp20GradeDirectionReady : Bool := false
    let properPipeLayoutReady : Bool := false
    let boundedReady := boundedBranchPlanPathReady && boundedBranchGradeMagnitudeReady && boundedBranchGradeDirectionReady && boundedBranchDrainCatchmentReady && boundedDeflectorGradeEnvelopeReady
    And (boundedReady = true)
      ((exactDeflectorElevationsReady || exactPipeCenterlineZReady || exactDrainRouteReady || wholeFp20GradeDirectionReady || properPipeLayoutReady) = false) :=
by decide
